name: fan
title: Fan
description: A compact control bar whose cells open in place: a label (a word or a glyph), the current choice that unfolds every choice into a grouped grid, and an options cap that stretches sideways into more controls. One open at a time; nothing hides in a menu.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/fan.md. SwiftUI: MetalFan in the MetalUI Swift package.
